name: iOS App Analysis
content:
Analyze the iOS application {app_name}.

**Binary extraction (jailbreak required) :**
```bash
# With frida-ios-dump
frida-ios-dump -U {app_name}

# With Clutch
Clutch -d {app_name}
```

**Static analysis :**
```bash
# Decompilation
class-dump -H App.decrypted -o headers/

# Strings
strings App.decrypted | grep -i "api\|secret\|password"

# Hopper/IDA for in-depth analysis
```

**Items to check :**
1. Info.plist : ATS, URL schemes
2. Keychain items
3. Data Protection class
4. Jailbreak detection
5. SSL pinning

**Frida :**
```javascript
// Bypass jailbreak detection
frida -U -f {app_name} -l jailbreak-bypass.js

// Dump keychain
objection -g {app_name} explore
> ios keychain dump
```

Tools : Frida, objection, Hopper, class-dump, ipatool
